/bin/bash -lc "python3 - << 'PY'
import pandas as pd, re
df_raw=pd.read_excel('field_visit_log.xlsx', header=None)
header_row=4
data=df_raw.iloc[header_row+1:].reset_index(drop=True)
cols=df_raw.iloc[header_row].tolist()
df=pd.DataFrame(data.values, columns=cols)
# clean column names strip
df.columns=[str(c).strip() if pd.notna(c) else '' for c in df.columns]
print(df.columns.tolist())
# Drop rows where Visit ID is NaN
df=df.dropna(subset=['Visit ID'])
# Normalize village names
def norm_village(v):
    if pd.isna(v): return ''
    s=str(v).strip()
    s=re.sub(r'\\s+', ' ', s)
    return s.lower()
df['Village_norm']=df['Village'].apply(norm_village)
# Deduplicate Visit ID keeping first occurrence
df=df.drop_duplicates(subset=['Visit ID'], keep='first')
# Clean travel reimbursement
def parse_money(x):
    if pd.isna(x): return 0
    s=str(x).strip()
    # remove ₹ and commas
    s=re.sub(r'[₹,]', '', s)
    try:
        return float(s)
    except:
        return 0
df['Travel_num']=df['Travel Reimbursement (INR)'].apply(parse_money)
# Filter
mask = (df['State'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()=='maharashtra') & (df['Programme'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()=='water security')
filtered=df[mask]
total=filtered['Travel_num'].sum()
print('rows', len(filtered))
print(filtered[['Visit ID','Village','Programme','State','Travel Reimbursement (INR)','Travel_num']].head(20))
print('total', total)
PY"
